generated_tile_root_cause: Chromium generated background patterns are picture shaders. The pinned SkPictureShader caches eight-bit tiles as RGBA8888, not native N32. On Linux, its image shader bypasses the N32-only legacy context. The Open UI concrete generated tile used N32 and therefore selected legacy sampling after the flag was enabled. Matching the generated tile representation repairs all 18 measured generated-background regressions while retaining native N32 scrollbar resources. Five other sampler regressions still prohibit promotion.
